description: This Java class 'ShutdownBehaviour' is responsible for managing the shutdown behavior of an Akka actor based on received shutdown commands. It subscribes to pub-sub topics and handles shutdown signals to terminate the actor gracefully if the shutdown reason applies to its namespace or entity ID.

classes.name: ShutdownBehaviour
classes.description: Final class managing the shutdown logic for an actor based on shutdown signals and pub-sub subscriptions.

methods.name: fromId
methods.description: Factory method to create ShutdownBehaviour instance with entity ID including namespace, and subscribe to pub-sub.

methods.name: fromIdWithoutNamespace
methods.description: Factory method to create ShutdownBehaviour instance with entity ID without namespace, and subscribe to pub-sub.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Creates an Akka ReceiveBuilder to handle incoming messages: shutdown commands and subscription acknowledgments.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Handles Shutdown messages; if the reason applies to this actor's namespace or entity, triggers actor shutdown.

methods.name: subscribeAck
methods.description: Handles pub-sub subscription acknowledgment; currently does nothing.
